card.text: Explore Europa in 3D with cssEarth. Inspect Voyager and Galileo imagery of Jupiter’s fractured icy moon and its orbit around Jupiter.

introduction.text: Europa is an icy moon of Jupiter. Its fractured surface and magnetic signature provide strong evidence for a salty ocean beneath the ice.

normal.title: Global image mosaic
normal.summary: Source detail ranges from 200 m to 20 km per pixel. Photographed shadows remain; the gray grid marks missing imagery.

enhanced.title: SSI enhanced-color mosaic
enhanced.summary: Enhanced colors are combined with monochrome detail. Where color is unavailable, gray imagery remains; the grid marks gaps in both.

elevation.title: Agenor Linea stereo terrain model
elevation.summary: Agenor Linea only, near 142°E and 44°S. Colors encode the released local stereo heights in meters; their relative datum is not a global reference level. Effective detail is about 3 km. Fixed northwest cartographic relief shows slopes; it is not part of the numeric scale. Gray grid preserves the DTM’s finite/no-data footprint. The archive’s duplicated, cubic-resampled quality products are excluded; colors imply no quality class or pointwise accuracy.

geology.title: USGS global geology (2024 SIM 3513)
geology.summary: USGS interpreted regional plains, bands, chaos terrains and crater deposits (2024; 1:15,000,000). Colors identify map units, not measured surface color. Gray grid marks no-data polygons. Fine line and point features are not represented by this polygon view.

infrared.title: Galileo NIMS spectral color
infrared.summary: Galileo NIMS observations assign red, green and blue to 1.50, 1.34 and 0.73–0.74 µm, following the archive guide. This false-color view shows spectral differences, not natural color or mineral abundance. The observations have Minnaert photometric correction; resolution, residual brightness and seams vary. Fixed channel stretches clip extreme values. Gray grid marks areas lacking a valid sample in any selected band.
